headline: South African Hospital Group Netcare Raises Dividend 17.6% on Digital Efficiency Gains
summary: Private healthcare operator Netcare posted higher annual earnings and raised its dividend by 17.6% ahead of Chief Executive Richard Friedland's planned departure.
why: Netcare is a primary private hospital network provider across South Africa.

impacts.name: Netcare
impacts.why: Netcare increased its full-year dividend payout by 17.6% on positive operating margins.
